verdict.rationale: Luma documents a first-party Dream Machine API for video generation. It has a generation endpoint, Python/JS/TS SDKs, API keys issued through the Luma API Platform, and text-to-video and image-to-video models, so job submission is clearly supported. The evidence does not describe how a job's status is polled or how the finished video is downloaded, and no OpenAPI spec was found (probe 404s), though that absence is not a contradiction. missing for 10: documented job-status/retrieval flow for finished assets, published API reference/OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of the submit-and-retrieve workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can submit a video generation job through a documented API and retrieve the finished asset

citations.quote: Dream Machine API let's developers use image and video generation capabilities.
